name: ComfyUI MiniMax H3 Motion Context V2 + Jupyter
readme:
ComfyUI with Jason's MiniMax H3 Motion Context V2 workflow (Singularity v2 int8 + ref2v turbo 4-step LoRA), ComfyUI-Easy-Media, KJNodes, SageAttention 2 and JupyterLab.

Ports: 8188 = ComfyUI, 8888 = JupyterLab, 22 = SSH.

First boot downloads ~56 GB of models into /workspace/models (watch /workspace/logs/models.log in Jupyter). Later boots skip anything already there.

The workflow is preloaded in ComfyUI's Workflows sidebar. Outputs and Easy-Media projects save to /workspace/output.

Recommended GPU: 48 GB+ (RTX PRO 6000, L40S, A6000) or RTX 5090. The nvfp4 text encoder runs fastest on Blackwell cards.
